title: Making Compost & Building a Composter
summary: Step-by-step winter compost production (greens/browns/manure, moisture, temperature rise) and building a local wooden or wire mesh composter.

pages.title: What is compost?
pages.text: It is the process of decomposing organic waste or materials through soil life, to transform them into a fertile substrate usable for crops.
pages.illustration_description: Illustration pédagogique pour Le compost, qu’est-ce que c’est ?
